unary_unary_RPC: invoke a unary-unary gRPC call without an explicit channel or stub
unary_stream_RPC: invoke a unary-stream gRPC call that returns an iterator of responses
stream_unary_RPC: invoke a stream-unary gRPC call with a request iterator and single response
stream_stream_RPC: invoke a stream-stream gRPC call with request and response iterators
ChannelCache_get_channel: get or create a cached gRPC channel with automatic eviction and reuse
